basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) has notified 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on a project-based engagement for 3 months initially, which can be extended until the project end. Candidates applying for this position must hold a BE / B.Tech (with GATE qualified) or Master's degree in Mechanical / Metallurgy / Materials / Production / Manufacturing Engineering / Material Science Engineering / Industrial Engineering / relevant branch of Engineering or Science. content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance

rows.details: Study of Fracture toughness (KIC/JIC) of additively manufactured IN718, IN625 and XH67 components in temperatures range of 77K-950K
3 months (initially) can be extended until the project end
Rs. 37,000/- p.m. Plus HRA provided as per institute norms

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the mandatory educational qualification to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Indore.

rows.essential_qualification_required: BE / B.Tech (with GATE qualified) or Master's degree in Mechanical / Metallurgy / Materials / Production / Manufacturing Engineering / Material Science Engineering / industrial Engineering / relevant branch of Engineering or Science.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- per month. House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be provided additionally as per institute norms. The appointment is for an initial duration of 3 months and can be extended until the completion of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed softcopy of your CV including all relevant Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates, and Date of Birth proof. Combine all required documents and certificates into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] . Ensure the application is submitted on or before 16 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Selected candidates will be intimated by email regarding the selection. The interview will be conducted in online or offline mode. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The tentative date of the interview is 3rd of October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the monthly fellowship for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month, plus HRA provided as per institute norms.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxations?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is provided as 3 years for OBC candidates, and 5 years for SC, ST, Physically Handicapped, and Female candidates against the upper age limit of 28 years.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on their CV and essential qualifications, and shortlisted applicants will be intimated by email for the online or offline interview.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be attached with the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach a detailed softcopy of their CV along with all relevant Essential Qualification Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets, GATE qualifying certificates, and Date of Birth certificate combined in a single PDF file.
